entities.summary: George Ronald Livingstone was an American professional basketball player. Livingstone was the sixth overall pick in the 1949 BAA draft by the Baltimore Bullets. He played for the Bullets for just sixteen games in his rookie season before he was traded to the Philadelphia Warriors for Ed Sadowski and cash. He played for the Warriors until 1951. Prior to the professional leagues, Livingstone was an AAU All-American while playing for the Oakland Bittners in 1946–47.
